info.name: Caiyun Weather Get Realtime Air Quality

params.name: token
params.description: Caiyun Weather API token issued by the Open Platform (platform.caiyunapp.com). Embedded in the path rather than a header.

params.name: lnglat
params.description: Longitude,latitude tuple as `lng,lat` (note the order — longitude first). Use WGS84 decimal degrees.

items.docs: Returns real-time air quality readings — PM2.5, PM10, O3, SO2, NO2, CO concentrations plus AQI values and category descriptions under both Chinese (HJ 633-2012) and US EPA standards.
